```yaml
name: Release Precompiled Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Validate tag version
        run: |
          TAG=$(git describe --tags)
          VERSION=$(grep '^version = "' Cargo.toml | cut -d '"' -f 2)
          if [[ "$TAG" != "v$VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Tag $TAG does not match version $VERSION in Cargo.toml"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create draft release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true

  build-linux-x86_64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        cuda-version: [11.8, 12.4, 13.0]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up CUDA
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit-action@v1
        with:
          cuda-version: ${{ matrix.cuda-version }}

      - name: Build CLI
        run: cargo build --release --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-linux-x86_64-${{ matrix.cuda-version }}.tar.gz
          path: target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/cake
          retention-days: 7

  build-linux-aarch64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Build CLI
        run: cross build --release --target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-linux-aarch64.tar.gz
          path: target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/cake
          retention-days: 7

  build-macos-arm64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Build CLI
        run: cargo build --release --target=aarch64-apple-darwin

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-macos-arm64.tar.gz
          path: target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/cake
          retention-days: 7

  build-android-aarch64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Install cross
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Build Mobile
        run: cross build --release --target=aarch64-linux-android

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-mobile-android-aarch64.tar.gz
          path: target/aarch64-linux-android/release/libcake_mobile.so
          retention-days: 7

  build-ios-arm64:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          brew install llvm
          export PATH="/usr/local/opt/llvm/bin:$PATH"

      - name: Build Mobile
        run: cargo build --release --target=aarch64-apple-ios

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-mobile-ios-arm64.tar.gz
          path: target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libcake_mobile.a
          retention-days: 7

  finalize-release:
    needs: [build-linux-x86_64, build-linux-aarch64, build-macos-arm64, build-android-aarch64, build-ios-arm64]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: cake-linux-x86_64-11.8.tar.gz
          path: artifacts/linux-x86_64-11.8
        run: mkdir -p artifacts/linux-x86_64-11.8 && mv cake-linux-x86_64-11.8.tar.gz artifacts/linux-x86_64-11.8/

      - name: Finalize release
        id: finalize_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ## Changelog
            <!-- Add changelog here -->
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.finalize_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: artifacts/linux-x86_64-11.8/cake-linux-x86_64-11.8.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-linux-x86_64-11.8.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip
```
